entwurf.thema: Claude Projects free vs paid, and no sourced Google TV ad removal

teile.name: Claim check
teile.text: Can Claude remove TV ads? Our sources don't document that. They do document Claude Projects, workspaces anyone can try.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: black-haired man in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits on a couch in a dim living room, frowning sideways at a wall-mounted TV, medium shot, cool blue light.

teile.name: What is documented
teile.text: Each project is a self-contained workspace with its own chat history and knowledge base, and free accounts get them.
teile.szene: Official Claude Help Center page on projects shown as a source card, top of the article with the definition of projects.

teile.name: Free limit
teile.text: Free users can create a maximum of five projects. You upload documents and context, then chat with Claude.
teile.szene: Help Center text about the free limit of five projects and uploading documents, shown as a source card.

teile.name: Instructions
teile.text: You can define project instructions for each project, for example asking Claude to use a more formal tone.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in leather jacket types thoughtfully at a desk in a night-lit apartment, over-the-shoulder medium shot, warm lamp glow.

teile.name: What paying adds
teile.text: So what does paying add? Near context limits, paid projects automatically use RAG mode, expanding capacity up to 10x.
teile.szene: Help Center passage on paid plans and RAG mode expanding project knowledge capacity up to 10x, shown as a source card.

teile.name: Usage and prices
teile.text: Projects draw from your plan's usage; check official pricing. Those TV ads? The page covers chats and files, not ad removal.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter stands before a dark living-room TV, arms crossed, thoughtful half-smile, wide shot, soft cyan rim light.

teile.name: Engagement
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in black leather jacket smiles and gives a thumbs up in a city apartment at dusk, medium shot, neon cyan highlights.

entwurf.beschreibung: Our sources don't document Claude removing TV ads. They do document Claude Projects: free accounts get up to five, and paid plans add RAG capacity of up to 10x.
